RenameImage.imageId: Accepts a single custom image ID; mutually exclusive with imageIds
RenameImage.imageIds: Accepts a list of custom image IDs (up to 100); mutually exclusive with imageId
RenameImage.name: Name of the custom image to create. Supports uppercase/lowercase letters, digits, Chinese characters, and special characters -_ /. Must start with a letter, length 1-65.
